name: patchpulse
description: PATCHPULSE — AI Civic Intelligence & Verification Platform for HACKDAY 1.0
author: Pochiraju Kailash Ram Markandeya Sharma <kailashsharma8>

scripts.build: npm run db:prep && npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/api run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm run db:prep && npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/api run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/web run build
scripts.render:build: node scripts/prepare-prisma.js && prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && ts-node --transpile-only ./prisma/seed.ts && npm --workspace=packages/shared run build && npm --workspace=apps/api run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=apps/api run lint && npm --workspace=apps/web run lint
scripts.db:push: npm run db:prep && prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma
